div.style: color: rgb(255, 179, 179) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
NOT DETERMINABLE.
No enum value exists for this claim —
the schema cannot express it.
A render-time lint rejects the phrase
in all generated text.

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WHAT HODI WILL — AND WILL NOT — SAY
Four typed evidence classes. No numeric score. No cross-class total.
Every record carries the literal: 'This record does not assert training-set membership.'

div.style: color: rgb(17, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Revocation terminates a grant. It does not un-train a model.
Numbers trace to /docs/metrics.json; accrual counts regenerate via `make metrics`.
